sources.use: Registered 5-ft normalized height data; independently count cells above 22m inside Purdue GIS FID 642.
supports: Two localized >22m cells in FID 642 at local X≈−13.53m, Y≈5.75–7.27m.
sources.limits: The two cells do not identify a penthouse or its form. At 5-ft resolution, the raster supports no 22x12m elevated box at either modeled end. The data cannot rule out a low or differently located penthouse.

sources.use: Building footprint mask for clipping and local registration inherited from R3–R7.
sources.limits: The campus building polygon is not an architectural roof or penthouse plan.

supports: A structural-steel mechanical penthouse and cantilevered roof truss are described.
sources.limits: No penthouse plan, dimensions, elevation, or local-frame location are published. This is why R8 removes the two modeled boxes without claiming that the real penthouse is absent.

sources.use: Official plan excerpt marks first-floor artwork positions and includes stair/room linework.
sources.limits: Only a cropped, partial first-floor plan is shown; it has no north arrow, scale, or controls for local-frame registration. Used for research and uncertainty documentation only; no stair, bridge, facade, or room geometry was changed from this sheet.

sources.publisher: Purdue University Office of Emergency Preparedness
sources.use: Confirms the building has one lower level, a grade level, and two upper floors.
sources.limits: This is not a dimensioned floor plan and does not locate interior circulation.

sources.publisher: Purdue University Office of Future Engineers
sources.use: Lists the Herman & Heddy Kurz Atrium and second-floor skywalk scenes; confirms names and level references.
sources.limits: Panorama scenes are not direction/position registered, so they cannot establish bridge endpoints or stair routes in the model.

sources.use: Qualitative visual check for brick, curtain glazing, red ACM and pronounced wing-like roof overhang.
sources.limits: Camera pose/bearing and control points are absent; image supports visual vocabulary, not exact facade station, roof edge, or dimensions.

registration_summary: R8 retains the registered GIS/LiDAR coordinate frame and master marker. The partial plan and 2016 photograph improve source coverage, but neither supports new local geometry registration. The only R8 geometry change is a LiDAR-supported correction to remove two large unsupported rooftop boxes.
